title: Custom CSV Transfer Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare CSV transfer file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that lists source and target plate slots and the volumes to transfer; include only rows with non‑zero volumes.

steps.title: Upload CSV to generate protocol
steps.instruction: Upload the prepared CSV file to the Custom CSV Transfer Protocol generator to create the robot script.

steps.title: Download generated protocol script
steps.instruction: Download the resulting Python protocol file from the generator.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol script.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to layout
steps.instruction: Place labware on the robot deck as specified in the deck map.

substeps.instruction: Slot 1 – Opentrons 300 µL pipette tips for the P50 single‑channel pipette.
Slot 2 – Corning 96‑well plate, flat 360 µL (ELISA plate A).
Slot 4 – Opentrons 300 µL pipette tips for the P300 8‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip racks, and both pipettes; follow the app’s prompts and use calibration tips as described in the support article.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate the labware in each slot.
Calibrate the tip racks in Slots 1 and 4.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App; the robot will execute the transfers, prompting you to refill tip racks if they become empty.
